Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 632 PM EST Mon Nov 16 2026
 

- Dry weather expected area-wide Monday through Thursday with 
temperatures above normal.

- Next chance for precipitation arrives this weekend with a cold 
frontal passage.

&&

.AVIATION...

High pressure anchored over the Ohio River Valley this evening will 
very slowly drop southeast towards the Central Appalachians over the 
next 24 to 48 hours. This will generally favor southwest flow across 
all terminals through Tuesday. Satellite imagery shows a pocket of 
thin high clouds moving over the area, thus have maintained BKN250 
mentions into the overnight hours. Once these high clouds depart 
around 08Z, there remains some potential for previously mentioned 
shallow ground fog. However, VFR conditions remain the predominant 
signal in model guidance, so continued to hold off on including 
BR/FG in the TAFs. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

*  None.
